notes: TROOP 0.3.8 adds a dedicated four-lane suspension proving ground to the debug world. Clearly signed packed-dirt lanes progress from speed-tuned washboard ripples through offset bumps and cross-axle potholes to a low-range rock crawl with a marked bike line and 10 m distance markers. Every rounded surface uses matching deterministic visual and physics geometry, preserves the existing vehicle speed-test corridor, and is covered by a real Jeep traversal regression.
